rationale: TICKET-BAZI-005 verified test baseline for BaZi Ten Gods and Shen Sha. The historical RED run of the unified-reading contract recorded UNIFIED_READING_TEN_GODS_MISSING before the source integration was completed. The contract has since been updated to exercise compute_natal_pillars directly. Current SHA-256 digests are recorded for both edited test files. The Node contract file was updated to accept either god or ten_god for hidden stems; the requested pytest commands do not execute that Node suite.
